# E030 -- Fiat Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** Fiat
- **Industry:** Automotive
- **Year:** 2019
- **Source file:** fiat-2019-br-pdf.pdf
- **Pages:** 80
- **Language:** PT-BR (Brazilian Portuguese)
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Titled "Guia de Branding" (Branding Guide), December 2019
- Opening statement: "This is the new Fiat. The guidelines contained here aim to inspire your creativity, not limit it."
- Three-pillar brand platform:
  - MARCA (Brand) -- "Nosso jeito de ser" (Our way of being) -- generates long-term differentiation
  - NEGOCIO (Business) -- "Nosso jeito de fazer" (Our way of doing) -- product and service alignment
  - COMUNICACAO (Communication) -- "Nosso jeito de falar" (Our way of speaking) -- personality-aligned messaging
- Brand purpose (Proposito) framed as the umbrella connecting all three pillars
- Brand personality: "Encantadora" (Enchanting) -- described as interested, interesting, creative, capable of bridging non-obvious universes
- Anti-definition: "Not naive or clueless"
- Business expression: "Fiat, Uau!" -- products and touchpoints should engage all 5 senses

## Tone of Voice
- Communication pillar explicitly defined as "our way of speaking"
- Brand personality "Encantadora" (Enchanting) guides tonal approach
- Emphasis on creativity, beauty, and reimagining the everyday ("the beautiful can redefine a static, slow, or lukewarm everyday")
- Anti-definition approach: defines what the brand is NOT as well as what it IS

## Outliers
- Brazilian market-specific guide (PT-BR) -- localized brand strategy rather than global corporate identity
- Unusually philosophical approach for an automotive brand -- emphasis on enchantment and sensory experience
- "New Fiat" framing suggests a brand repositioning or relaunch moment
- The "inspire, not limit" opening sets an unusual creative-freedom tone for a brand guideline document
- Presentation format (1920x1080) -- designed as a screen presentation, not a print document
